jobs.title: Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight Lead
jobs.description: Trust unlocks our greatest potential. For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution. What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’. What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight team as an Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight Lead? Reporting to the Head of Embedded Banking Financial Crime Oversight, you will coordinate thorough assessments of new Embedded Banking Partners to evaluate their financial crime controls, with emphasis on outsourced processes. You must understand their Operating Model, including systems, processes, and sub-contractors. After onboarding, you will monitor these partners' financial crime controls, assess risks using ClearBank’s taxonomy and relevant data, and ensure compliance with the Oversight model, including leading governance sessions. Your role includes: Ensuring and overseeing compliance with all internal policies, standards, industry guidance and regulation Leading the completion of the Financial Crime Systems and Controls Assessments for all new Embedded Banking relationships in accordance with policies, standards, and pro

jobs.description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. We're looking for an experienced individual to fill the role of Senior Collections Advisor. This position requires an important balance of both credit and conduct risk as we focus on delivering the right outcomes for our customers based on their individual circumstances, always. You will be working alongside as part of small but rapidly expanding team in our Milton Keynes office, this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our Milton Keynes office with flexibility on the other 2. There will also be a requirement to attend our central London office once a month (fully expensed). The ideal candidate will have excellent attention to detail and be comfortable following documented procedures consistently ensuring that all customers are treated fairly and receive the appropriate outcomes. Maintain reconciliations for deferred revenue, player balances, prepayments and fixed assets, and accrue key supplier costs.

jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. Position Overview As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue. You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win. If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description: Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale. Role Overview This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs. You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number. The role is deliberately hands on . You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you. Why this role is exciting You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck. You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness. You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically. You’ll work directly with the Group CFO , with fast decisions and no corporate red tape. Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval. You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on , high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast. What we expect from you Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers.
